reuse.why: Extends the existing shared isWeekendOrHoliday predicate and reuses monthUtils.dayFromDate.

duplication.why: The MM-DD match is added once in the predicate that all holiday checks (getNextDate, app.ts, schedule shifting) already call.

placement.why: The rule lives in shared/schedules.ts beside the existing holiday logic, with the format documented on RecurConfig.

scope.why: Only the predicate, two focused tests and a type comment change.

maintainability.why: A minimal single-point change that is easy to read and own.
